_about:
Research framework blocks for each stock's Fair Value drawer -> data/framework.json. Information only: nothing here
changes a fair value.

questions.A1: Earnings yield vs high-quality company bonds
questions.A3: Is the earnings spread positive or negative?
questions.A4: Today's spread vs its own historical median
questions.A5: Expensive vs bonds by its own history?
questions.A6: Same currency and a comparable horizon?
questions.A7: Extra return for taking equity risk
questions.B9: EPS growth from revenue vs margins
questions.B12: How reliable analyst forecasts have been
questions.B13: Is growth speeding up or slowing?
questions.B14: Earnings growing faster than revenue, and why
questions.C17: Can it raise prices without losing customers?
questions.C19: How easily can competitors copy it?
questions.C23: How long the advantage can last
questions.D24: Free cash flow growing with earnings?
questions.D25: Share of net income that becomes free cash flow
questions.D26: Cash flow from operations or working capital?
questions.D27: Capex needed to maintain the business
questions.D30: Can it fund growth without borrowing or issuing shares?
questions.E31: Share of earnings paid as dividends
questions.E33: Buybacks below or above intrinsic value?
questions.E34: Retained capital earning above its cost?
questions.E36: Creating value per share or just size?
questions.F37: Volatility of revenue, earnings and cash flow
questions.F39: Debt to refinance in the next 1-5 years
questions.F40: Cash flow covers interest and debt?
questions.F41: Dependence on few customers, suppliers or markets
questions.F43: Earnings fall in a realistic bad scenario
questions.G45: Price rise from earnings vs a higher P/E
questions.G46: Better or worse than its sector and the market?
questions.G50: Expected return if the multiple goes back to its average
questions.M1: EPS growth implied by today's price
questions.M4: Enough room to reinvest for that growth?
questions.M5: What if growth is half the implied rate?
questions.M6: What if the P/E falls to the sector median?
questions.M8: Each scenario vs the bond yield
questions.M9: Return from business growth vs a re-rating
questions.M10: Is the valuation premium covered by the advantage?
questions.T1: Share of value from cash 5, 10, 20 and 30+ years away
questions.T2: How much the value moves if interest rates change
questions.T3: Does your holding period cover where the value comes from?
questions.T4: How reliable are the assumptions behind distant cash flows?
